job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy NLP models using various machine learning algorithms to solve complex business problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet customer needs.
Develop data pipelines to extract insights from large datasets and integrate them into existing systems.
Troubleshoot issues related to model performance, data quality, and system integration.
Work with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop solutions that meet those needs.
Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in NLP and machine learning.

Job Requirements :

5-7 years of experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP) engineering or a related field.
Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience working with popular libraries like scikit-learn or TensorFlow.
Experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation, Vector Database, and Generative AI is desirable.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
